caption: Both rules fit the 20 training emails equally well (10% error), but on the 100 test emails the simple rule h2 (3 conditions) has a 10 percentage-point gap while the complex h1 (30 conditions) has 25. Same fit, different generalization — the preference for simpler rules is the inductive bias, and the test set is what proves it useful.

spec.title: Same training error: h2 (3 conditions) beats h1 (30 conditions)
spec.aria: A table with columns training error, test error and gap, for two rules. h1 (30 conditions) has 10% training error, 35% test error and a 25 percentage-point gap; h2 (3 conditions) has the same 10% training error but 20% test error and a 10 percentage-point gap.
